content.text:
## Governance model (two tracks)

RootMC has **citizen legislation** (weekly bill pipeline) and **community polls** (weighted Council votes). They share voting power math and D1 tables but differ in lifecycle.

| Track | IDs | Where discussion lives | Where voting lives |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Citizen proposals** | `PROP-*` (`rootmc_legislation_items`) | `#proposals` forum thread | Auto-opens poll in `#voting` (`kind=legislation`) |
| **Community polls** | Same `PROP-*` or allocated codes (`rootmc_community_proposals`) | `#governance` announce + operations forum thread | `#voting` (grants/bills) or **operations forum** (general/season) |
| **Weekly bills** | `BILL-*` | `#proposals` thread after compile | `#voting` when bill enters voting |

**Vote weight:** `playtime_seconds × vote_points` → normalized **share %** (sums to 100%). Eligibility: linked MC+Discord, ≥1h playtime, terms accepted. Quorum for pass: **5 linked voters** (general polls). Majority: **>50%** of cast weighted votes. Grants need **24h sustained majority**.

---

| **Operations forum** (staff `/proposal create`, appeals) | `1516143406315737169` | `DISCORD_ROOTMC_OPERATIONS_FORUM_CHANNEL_ID` |
| **Proposals forum** (citizen legislature threads) | **`1526664180491358419`** (canonical in code) | `DISCORD_ROOTMC_PROPOSALS_CHANNEL_ID` |
| **Governance discussion** | `1522406451413385317` | `DISCORD_ROOTMC_GOVERNANCE_CHANNEL_ID` |
| **#voting** (official Council polls) | `1522413185364398090` | `DISCORD_ROOTMC_VOTING_CHANNEL_ID` |

| **Council voters role** | `1522410660418551910` | `DISCORD_ROOTMC_COUNCIL_VOTERS_ROLE_ID` |

---

## API routes (`api.rootmc.net` → `/api/governance/*`)

Routed via `realm-router.ts` → `handleGovernanceWebRoutes` / `handleGovernanceRoutes`.

### Public read (no auth) — **best for Ava vote %**

| Method | Path | Returns |
|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/governance/polls` | Open polls + `weighted_for_pct`, `weighted_against_pct`, `weighted_abstain_pct`, `leading_majority`, grant hold state |
| GET | `/api/governance/votes/{proposalId}` | Single poll metadata + tallies + `my_vote` if signed in |
| GET | `/api/governance/council` | Voter roster, open polls, full `policy` object (thresholds, grant rules, listing sites) |
| GET | `/api/governance/proposals` | Citizen legislation items (`?status=pending,included,retracted`) |
| GET | `/api/governance/proposals/{id}` | Item + `poll_id` / `bill_poll_id` |
| GET | `/api/governance/bills`, `/bills/{id}` | Weekly bills + amendments |
| GET | `/api/governance/voting-power?uuid=` or `?discord_user_id=` | Eligibility + `share_percent` |
| GET | `/api/governance/leaderboard` | Top 25 by governance power |
| GET | `/api/governance/terms` | Terms version/summary |

**Implementation:** `D:\.1 Work Stations\RootMC\Web Files\rootmc-realm-api\src\rootmc-governance-web.ts`  
**Tally logic:** `voteTallies()` / `openCouncilPolls()` in same file; Discord embed mirrors in `rootmc-community-proposals.ts` → `tallyVotes()`.

### Auth required (Bearer session from Discord sign-in)

| Method | Path | Action |
|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/governance/proposals` | Submit citizen proposal (title, description, category) |
| POST | `/api/governance/proposals/{id}/retract` | Author retract |
| POST | `/api/governance/votes/{proposalId}` | Cast `for` / `against` / `abstain` |
| POST | `/api/governance/grant-proposals` | Treasury grant request |
| POST | `/api/governance/bills/{id}/amendments` | Bill amendment |
| POST | `/api/governance/bills/compile` | Staff compile weekly bill |
| POST | `/api/governance/terms/accept` | Accept ToS |
| GET | `/api/governance/me` | Signed-in eligibility snapshot |

### Discord bot (not HTTP, but same backend)

| Endpoint | Notes |
|---|---|
| `POST /v1/discord/rootmc/interactions` | `/proposal`, `/vote`, vote button components (`rootmc_prop:vote:{id}:{choice}`) |

**Files:**
- `D:\.1 Work Stations\RootMC\Web Files\rootmc-realm-api\src\discord-rootmc-bot.ts`
- `D:\.1 Work Stations\RootMC\Web Files\rootmc-realm-api\src\rootmc-community-proposals.ts` — `handleProposalSlashCommand`, `createCommunityProposal`, `castProposalVote`

### Unrelated “vote” endpoints (Minecraft listing rewards, not governance)

- `POST /api/rootmc/votes/claims-credit`, `claims-backfill` — Votifier payout backfill
- `GET /ingame-chat/poll` — MC↔Discord chat bridge

---

## Ava bot (`rootmc-sexi` / Ava Ivy) — what’s implementable today

**Existing Ava setup:**
- `D:\.1 Work Stations\RootMC\Web Files\rootmc-sexi\src\config.mjs` — watches proposals forum `1526664180491358419`, admins, general
- `...\src\persona.mjs` — “Features need proposals + votes”
- `...\PROPOSAL.md` — local Discord assistant; **no governance API integration yet**

| Capability | Status | How |
|---|---|---|
| **Check vote %** | Ready now | `GET https://api.rootmc.net/api/governance/votes/{id}` or `/polls` / `/council` — no auth |
| **List open polls + leading majority** | Ready now | `/api/governance/polls` |
| **Explain eligibility / user %** | Ready now | `/api/governance/voting-power?discord_user_id=` |
| **Draft proposal text in thread** | Ready now | Ava already watches proposals forum; Grok synthesis on server side reads thread when bill compiles |
| **Submit official proposal** | Needs user auth | `POST /api/governance/proposals` with user Bearer token, or user runs `/proposal submit` in Discord |
| **Create staff poll** | Staff only | `/proposal create` (Discord) → `createCommunityProposal()` |
| **Cast votes** | Per-user only | Site `POST .../votes/{id}` or Discord buttons — cannot proxy without user session |
| **Auto-post draft to forum** | Possible | Would need `DISCORD_ROOTMC_BOT_TOKEN` or Sexi bot token + `createForumPostThread` pattern from `rootmc-legislature.ts` — but submission still needs linked proposer |

**Practical Ava flow:**
1. Help user draft title/body/category in `#proposals` thread.
2. Poll `GET /api/governance/votes/{poll_id}` (from `proposals/{id}` → `poll_id`) to report “For 62.3% / Against 28.1%”.
3. Point user to `https://rootmc.net/governance/submit/` or `/proposal submit` to file officially.

**Gap:** `rootmc-sexi` has no `api.rootmc.net` client yet — only wiki URL scraping in `siteContext.mjs`. Adding ~3 public GET calls would unlock vote monitoring.
